faq.q: How much does Rawlins Law Accident & Injury Attorneys charge?
faq.a: Rawlins Law Accident & Injury Attorneys publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Rawlins Law Accident & Injury Attorneys offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Rawlins Law Accident & Injury Attorneys publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock, the firm states it will visit clients in hospital or at home and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Rawlins Law Accident & Injury Attorneys have offices?
faq.a: Rawlins Law Accident & Injury Attorneys publishes two offices, in San Diego and Escondido. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Are the case results Rawlins Law Accident & Injury Attorneys publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Rawlins Law Accident & Injury Attorneys publishes twelve case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Past results do not predict another case.
